$comment: Validates _source/notice-reasons.json, which is the single source of truth for tables T-233 and T-234 of FR-076 (CR-712).

The schema sees the SHAPE. What JSON Schema cannot say -- a row id written twice, a wordsOf that names no row, or a row of another manner or display, an invariantRefusals.wordsOf key that is no row of table T-220 -- is refused by notice_reasons_json_to_md.py.
title: The notice roster manuscript
description: Tables T-233 and T-234: per reason and per question, its scene, manner, source and how it is displayed.

prose.description: One printed cell, one string per language (check 23). The string is the Markdown the table prints, byte for byte.

columns.description: The printed column headings, one list per language.

table.description: The id, caption and column headings a printed table carries.

manner.description: A row id of table T-037 (the manner of telling).

reasonDisplay.description: How a reason reaches the screen: show (stands until NT-8 dismisses it), autoDismiss (leaves by itself, NT-2), hide (never on the screen), report (a line of the Import Report inside one reading).

reasonRow.description: A row id of table T-233.

reasons.description: Table T-233, in its printed order.

wordsOf.description: The row whose words the screen prints for this one. Omitted when the row has words of its own.

questions.description: Table T-234, in its printed order.

display.description: ask, or ask only while the document holds an unsaved edit.

invariantRefusals.description: The rows of table T-220 an import refusal carries, held as one family rather than row by row (the table already gives each one its id).

wordsOf.description: Per row of table T-220, the row of table T-233 whose words the screen prints instead.
